verdict.rationale: OCI documents a CLI with the same core functionality as the Console plus extra commands, installable on Linux, Mac and Windows. It also documents REST APIs, multi-language SDKs and an official Terraform provider, all of which can drive the platform programmatically without the UI. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline guidance (e.g., GitHub Actions or other runner integrations), documented non-interactive machine credentials suited to CI (the cited token-based auth may be session-oriented), and independent hands-on corroboration of automating OCI from CI.
